parts.text: Architectural placement analysis only. Do not evaluate Agents.md or send-to-gemini.js for compliance with step-3-evaluation.json, and do not modify any files. Determine where the new canonical ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/tests/step-3-evaluation.json belongs in the active Gemini Supervisor architecture. Compare the current Agents.md and send-to-gemini.js structure to the new evaluation artifact and identify: (1) the exact places in Agents.md that should reference or define use of this artifact for Step 3; (2) the exact places in send-to-gemini.js that should load, inject, validate, or otherwise consume it; (3) which existing dependencies on evaluation-tests.md, step-3-test-return-schema.md, or other historical/test files should be replaced or removed; (4) whether the heuristic and Step3_TSR corpus should be loaded together or separately at runtime; (5) the minimal source and Agents.md changes required to integrate this artifact without duplicating its contents into Agents.md. Return a factual integration map with current-file references and recommended insertion/replacement points. This is placement analysis, not a compliance score and not a paired revision.
